# opnsense_firewall_alias_settings (Resource)

Firewall alias settings (**Firewall ▸ Aliases ▸ GeoIP settings**): the source of the GeoIP database used by `geoip` aliases. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `firewall_alias_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_firewall_alias_settings.this
  id = "firewall_alias_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_firewall_alias_settings" "this" {
  geoip_url = "https://download.maxmind.com/app/geoip_download?edition_id=GeoLite2-Country-CSV&license_key=${var.maxmind_key}&suffix=zip"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `geoip_url` (String) Location to fetch geoip address ranges from. Refer to the OPNsense documentation for further details.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `firewall_alias_settings`.
